stories.title: Mexican drug kingpin Miguel Ángel Félix Gallardo, known as the 'Boss of bosses,' dies at 80
stories.summary: Former drug kingpin Miguel Ángel Félix Gallardo, considered one of the godfathers of drug trafficking in Mexico, died Sunday at age 80.

stories.title: At vigil to remember loved ones lost in crashes, Durham families, survivors call for safer streets
stories.summary: During vigil in Durham, families and crash survivors shared personal stories and called on city leaders to make roads safer in the Bull City.

stories.title: Cat missing since Brooklyn building collapse found after child's tearful plea
stories.summary: Issac the cat, feared lost in the deadly Brooklyn building collapse, has been found alive and was reunited with his 13-year-old owner.

stories.title: What to know about the 69th Grammy nominations, presenters and more
stories.summary: This year's Grammy nominations announcement, set to take place Nov. 16, is gearing up to be a star-studded event.

stories.title: Emergency crews responding to vessel collision near Port of New Orleans on Mississippi River
stories.summary: It will take weeks for the cruise ship to be removed, officials said.

stories.title: From car trunk to Hill Street: Inside NC's only Black-owned children's bookstore
stories.summary: North Carolina's only Black-owned children's bookstore is building community in Raleigh after reopening following a closure prompted by racist threats.

stories.title: Beloved Raleigh mail carrier honored by hundreds of neighbors before retirement
stories.summary: A Raleigh neighborhood surprised retiring mail carrier Carlton Sutton with a community celebration honoring his decades of service.

stories.title: Officials say a tanker's steering failed before it crashed into a cruise ship in New Orleans
stories.summary: U.S. government safety officials say a preliminary finding indicates a tanker's steering system failed before it crashed into a cruise ship docked in New Orleans.

stories.title: RDU travelers navigate lingering delays, lost luggage after nationwide FAA ground stop
stories.summary: RDU travelers continued dealing with delays, canceled flights and missing luggage days after a nationwide FAA ground stop disrupted air travel.

stories.title: Former NC lawmaker Jason Saine, nonprofit treasurer indicted on felony charges
stories.summary: Former state Rep. Jason Saine and Greater Carolina treasurer David Coble face felony charges alleging misuse of nonprofit funds for personal expenses.

stories.title: NASA's Voyager 1 closes in on a light-day in interstellar space for a new distance record
stories.summary: NASA's Voyager 1 is about to become humanity's first object to reach one light-day from Earth, which is a mind-blowing distance of more than 16 billion miles.
